name: hermes-profile-evolution
description: Portable request adapter for target-sovereign Hermes profile evolution. It builds a closed version-1 proposal envelope and forwards it to the canonical hermes profile-request command. The Claude command and file-edit hook live under com.infiquetra.claude.
